description: This file defines a template class 'sequential_metrics_executor' which decorates a task executor to track performance metrics such as latency, enqueue/defer counts, and resource usage. It includes methods for executing and deferring tasks with metric collection and periodic reporting. It is specific to sequential executors within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: sequential_metrics_executor
classes.description: A template class that decorates a task executor to measure and report performance metrics such as latency, resource usage, and task counts for sequential executors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Attempts to execute a task, collecting metrics such as latency and resource usage, and manages task pooling.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task for later execution, with metric collection similar to 'execute'.

methods.name: handle_metrics
methods.description: Updates internal metrics and reports them periodically, including latency, counts, and resource usage.
